verses.en: O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.
verses.sm: Atua e, na e lafoaiina i matou, na e faataapeapeina i matou, na e toatamai; ia e toe liliu mai ia te i matou.

verses.en: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.
verses.sm: Nae luluina le eleele, na e faamavaevaeina; ia e fofoina ona gaugau; aua o loo lulu ja.

verses.en: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.
verses.sm: Na e faailoa mai mea faigata i lou nuu; na e faainumia i matou i le uaina e tautevateva ai.

verses.en: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
verses.sm: Nae foaiina atu le tagavai mo e matatau ia te oe, e siitia i luga ona o le upu moni. Sela.

verses.en: That thy beloved may be delivered; save with thy right hand, and hear me.
verses.sm: Ina ia laveaiina au pele; ia e faaola mai i lou aao taumatau, ma ja e tali mai ja te au.

verses.en: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai mai le Atua i lona malumalu, Ou te fiafia lava a‘u, ou te tofitofia Sekema, o le vanu o Sukota:ou te fuafuatia lea.

verses.en: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;
verses.sm: O loo ia te au Kiliata, o loo ia te au foi Manase; e fai foi Efaraima ma malosi o loʻu ulu; o laʻu faipule o Iuta lea;

verses.en: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.
verses.sm: o Moapio le ipu lea ou te mulumulu ai; ou te lafoina loʻu seevae i Etoma; Filisitia E, ina alaga ia i lou manumalo ja te au.

verses.en: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
verses.sm: O aise na te avea aʻu i le aai nofo ‘olo? O ai se na te taʻitaʻiina aʻu i Etoma?

verses.en: Wilt not thou, O God, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O God, which didst not go out with our armies?
verses.sm: to Eleo oe ea, le Atua e, sa e lafoaiina mai i matou, ma ua e le afio atu, le Atua e, faatasi ma la matou itu taua?

verses.en: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.
verses.sm: Ia e fesoasoani mai ia te i matou i le puapuaga; auā e le aoga lava le olataga mai tagata.

verses.en: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
verses.sm: Ole Atua lava e fai ai i matou ma toa; auā O ja na te solia e ua ita mai ja te i matou. 6l,
